body: Manish Mohnot (MD & CEO) on 2025-02-14 (Q3FY25 concall transcript): "we believe that we should be going back to that double-digit growth in that business from next year onwards" Metric: Water revenue growth. Target: >=+10% (later '20-25%'). Deadline: 2026-03-31. Specificity: vague; prompted by analyst. Status as of 2026-11-21: unverifiable. Evidence: FY26 water revenue INR 2,112 cr (Q4FY26 call), but the FY25 water base is not given in the calls read; quarterly FY26 was -5% (Q1, Q2) and lower in Q3, then +40% QoQ in Q4.
